Overview

Ballarat is a city in Victoria with a population of 116,201. Victoria’s historic gold rush city with Sovereign Hill, grand Victorian architecture, and a vibrant arts scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
